item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Creates `program = dspy.Predict(MySig)` once and reuses `program` for both calls without rebuilding or swapping signatures."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Edits the signature task wording between calls via `MySig.instructions = \"Updated instruction.\"`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Calls the predictor once before and once after the edit, so the second LM request reflects the updated class instructions."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `lm.history[0]` and `lm.history[1]` system-message contents as the proof source rather than object inspection."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Prints both system messages and asserts the first has only the original instruction while the second has only the updated instruction."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
